contexts.title: Harborline Cold Chain Monitor pricing and hardware sheet
contexts.text:
Harborline Cold Chain Monitor - Pricing and Hardware Sheet 2026
Harborline Systems | Rep and partner use | Effective 1 February 2026

WHAT IT DOES
Harborline Cold Chain Monitor watches refrigerated storage and transport for food distributors, commissaries and grocery warehouses. Wireless sensors report to a gateway, the gateway reports to the Harborline cloud, and the cloud alerts staff when a reading leaves the allowed band and builds audit-ready logs.

Measured signals: temperature, door-open events, gateway connectivity and sensor battery level. Nothing else is measured today.

HARDWARE (one-time, customer owns the hardware once paid)
- HL-T3 wireless temperature sensor: $89 each. Range -40 C to +85 C, accuracy +/-0.3 C. Each unit ships with a NIST-traceable calibration certificate valid for 24 months.
- HL-D1 door-open sensor: $45 each.
- HL-G2 gateway (Wi-Fi or Ethernet): $340 each. One gateway covers up to 60 sensors within about 100 m indoors.
- HL-G2C cellular gateway for trucks and trailers: $520 each, includes 24 months of cellular data; after that $9 per gateway per month.
- Replacement battery pack: $12. Batteries are user-replaceable.

BATTERY LIFE (HL-T3)
- 10-minute logging interval (default): about 3 years.
- 1-minute logging interval: about 18 months.
Battery life drops in freezers below -25 C; plan on roughly 20% shorter life there.

SUBSCRIPTION (per HL-T3 sensor per month, billed annually)
- Standard: $6 per sensor per month. Email and push alerts, dashboards, 7-year log history, PDF temperature logs.
- Premium: $9 per sensor per month. Adds SMS and automated voice-call alerts, escalation chains and 24/7 alert support.
- Volume pricing at 250+ sensors on one contract: Standard $5, Premium $7.50 per sensor per month.
- Door sensors are $2 per door sensor per month on either plan. Gateways carry no subscription fee.

INSTALLATION
- Remote-guided self-install: free, with a 60-minute video session.
- On-site installation: $1,200 per site for up to 150 sensors, plus $6 per additional sensor at that site.
- Installation fee waivers are not pre-approved; route any request to the regional sales manager in writing.

LEAD TIME AND SHIPPING
- 3 to 4 weeks from purchase order for orders under 500 sensors; larger orders are quoted individually.
- Ships to the United States and Canada.

PILOT PROGRAM
- 45-day pilot: up to 25 sensors and 1 gateway, $1,500 flat.
- The $1,500 is credited in full against the first-year subscription if the customer signs within 30 days of the pilot ending.
- Pilot hardware can be kept if the customer signs; otherwise it is returned prepaid.

RULES FOR REPS
Quote list prices only. Discounts beyond the volume tier need regional sales manager approval. Do not quote battery life beyond the figures above.

contexts.title: Harborline support, warranty, compliance and terms
contexts.text:
Harborline Cold Chain Monitor - Support, Warranty, Compliance and Terms
Harborline Systems | Version 3.1 | Owner: Customer Operations and Legal

ALERTING
- Standard plan: email and mobile push alerts.
- Premium plan: adds SMS and automated voice-call alerts and escalation chains (for example, night-shift lead first, then warehouse manager after 10 minutes without acknowledgement).
- If a gateway loses its connection, each HL-T3 sensor keeps logging locally for up to 30 days and back-fills the cloud when the connection returns.

SUPPORT
- Standard: email support Monday to Friday, 7am to 7pm Eastern. First response within 1 business day.
- Premium: 24/7 phone support for alerting outages. Priority 1 first response within 30 minutes.

HARDWARE WARRANTY
- 24-month limited warranty from the ship date on sensors and gateways. Batteries are consumables and are not covered.
- In-warranty failures are replaced through an RMA request in the dashboard; an advance replacement ships within 2 business days and the failed unit is returned in the prepaid box.
- Out-of-warranty replacements are sold at list price less 20%.
- Physical damage, water immersion beyond the rated seal, and opened housings void the warranty.

DATA AND COMPLIANCE
- Temperature readings cannot be edited or deleted by any user. Corrective-action notes can be attached to an excursion; every note is stored with the user name and a timestamp.
- Log history is retained for 7 years by default for food safety audits.
- Exports: PDF temperature logs, CSV raw data, and a traceability export formatted for the FDA Food Traceability Rule (FSMA 204) key data elements.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA. Data encrypted at rest and in transit. Hosted in the United States.

SERVICE LEVEL
- Premium: 99.9% monthly availability for the alerting service, with a 10% service credit on that month's Premium fee if missed. Credit is the sole remedy.
- Standard: no contractual availability commitment.

COMMERCIAL TERMS
- Subscriptions are annual, invoiced upfront, Net 30.
- Hardware is invoiced on shipment, Net 30.
- Auto-renewal for 12 months unless cancelled with 45 days written notice.
- After termination, the customer has 60 days to export all logs; data is then permanently deleted.
- Sensors can be added mid-term at the prorated subscription rate; sensor count can only be reduced at renewal.

ESCALATION
Non-standard terms, custom compliance attestations and security questionnaires go to Legal via the deal desk. Reps must not confirm certifications or regulatory validations that are not listed on this sheet.

contexts.title: Harborline distributor price list (merged revision)
contexts.text:
Harborline Cold Chain - Distributor Price List (Northeast Channel, merged revision)
Prepared by the channel team for distributor sales reps. Some rows were carried over from the 2025 list.

HARDWARE
| Item | Distributor list |
| HL-T3 temperature sensor | $89 |
| HL-D1 door sensor | $45 |
| HL-G2 gateway | $290 |
| HL-G2C cellular gateway | $520 (12 months of cellular data included) |
Note: HL-G2 gateway list price moves to $340 effective 1 July.

BATTERY
HL-T3 battery lasts up to 5 years.
Spec footnote: about 3 years at the default 10-minute logging interval.

SUBSCRIPTION
Standard $6 and Premium $9 per sensor per month, billed annually. Volume pricing from 200 sensors.

PILOT OFFER FOR DISTRIBUTOR ACCOUNTS
Headline: 90-day pilot, 25 sensors and a gateway, $1,500.
Terms line: pilot runs as a 45-day evaluation; fee credited if the customer signs within 30 days of the end.

CELLULAR
The HL-G2C includes 24 months of data, then $9 per gateway per month.

WARRANTY
24 months on all hardware.

INSTALLATION
On-site installation is available through Harborline or through certified distributor installers. Distributor installers set their own rates; Harborline on-site installation is quoted per site.

LEAD TIMES
Standard lead time is 3 to 4 weeks from purchase order. Distributor stock in the Northeast warehouse may ship sooner; ask the channel manager for current stock levels before promising a date.

ORDERING NOTES
- Quote hardware and subscription on separate lines.
- Pilot hardware is shipped from Harborline directly, not from distributor stock.
- Do not combine the pilot offer with any other promotion.

Channel reps should confirm current prices with the Harborline channel manager before sending a quote.
contexts.notes: Contradictions: (1) HL-G2 gateway $290 in the table vs $340 effective 1 July note; (2) battery "up to 5 years" vs about 3 years at the default interval; (3) pilot headline 90-day vs terms line 45-day evaluation; (4) cellular gateway 12 months of data included in the table vs 24 months in the Cellular section; (5) volume pricing from 200 sensors vs 250+ on the official sheet.
